visual_name: Day in the life, part thirty six: the recipe tab (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js gamer room (dark walls, colour-cycling RGB strips, posters, a figurine shelf, a window whose blinds open on the turn), a desk with two monitors, a glowing keyboard and a can, a gaming chair that spins, a browser drawn on the monitor with 47 tabs that shrink to icons and an upload that gets closed at 99%, box-built creator in a black hoodie with a headset and teal-tipped hair, phone sheets for the browser / a home screen with the YourBrand icon / Welcome back, signed in / brief, content and campaigns, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 39.6 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: in his gamer room a creator has forty seven tabs open: the brief, the brand's folder, his upload, three tabs called untitled, a recipe from 2019. The tabs are so small they're just icons; he closes one and it's the upload, at ninety nine percent. He spins in his chair. Then YourBrand: it sits on his home screen like an app; one tap and he's in, still signed in, with the brief, his uploads and his campaigns. He still has forty six tabs. He can't close the recipe.
